records.issue_text: The credential-sync webhook performs a non-atomic read-then-create, allowing concurrent or retried webhooks to create duplicate credentials and later update an arbitrary duplicate.
records.rationale: The diff shows in apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts a pattern where it first does findFirst to check if credential exists, then either updates or creates. This is a classic TOCTOU (time-of-check-time-of-use) race condition. Between the findFirst and create calls, another concurrent request could create the same credential, resulting in duplicates. The code at lines 56-66 shows findFirst
